parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for distinct compounds tested in human assays against the target CHEMBL5162 (neuropeptide S receptor). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to filter by target CHEMBL ID and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return only compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
